summary.text: Stephanie McClintock is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives for District 18-Position 1, in office since January 9, 2023, and she is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Randi Knott.
A former Battle Ground school board member, she is the ranking Republican on the Consumer Protection and Business Committee.

paragraphs.text: McClintock was born in Fountain Valley, California, graduated from Fountain Valley High School and lives in Vancouver, Washington, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a bachelor's degree in business from Concordia University, and her career has included human resources work and work as an event planner for Holland Residential.
She was vice chair of the Clark County Republican Party from December 2010 to June 2012 and chair from June to December 2012.
McClintock served on the Battle Ground School Board from 2013 to 2017.

Her House Republican biography says she is ranking Republican member of the Consumer Protection and Business Committee, assistant ranking member of the Capital Budget Committee and a member of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, and that she works in public relations for United Grain Corporation.
It lists public safety and expanded technical and trades programs in high schools among her priorities.
